collection_note: The agentic-workflows logs tool completed pagination of the 24-hour window in 21 batches, but its responses exposed only cache paths. The supplied security limits prohibit reading cache files. The exposed read-only GitHub tools did not include a workflow-runs endpoint, so run classifications, safe outputs, engagement, durations, token usage, costs, and quality metrics could not be extracted. Null values mean unavailable. The required executed field is set to 0 only for the run-classification consistency check and is not a measured zero.
